prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-16.9s) - Introduction to calculus
title = Text("What is Calculus?", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("The Mathematics of Change", font_size=36)
subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.wait(1)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.wait(11.9)  # Complete 16.9s segment

# Segment 2 (16.9-28.7s) - Examples of change
axes = Axes(
    x_range=[0, 5],
    y_range=[0, 5],
    axis_config={"include_tip": True}
).scale(0.7).shift(DOWN)

# Car speed curve
speed_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: 0.5*x**2, color=BLUE)
speed_label = Text("Speed vs. Time", font_size=24).next_to(axes, UP)

# Water level curve
water_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: x, color=GREEN)
water_label = Text("Water Level", font_size=24).next_to(axes, UP)

self.play(
    FadeOut(subtitle),
    Create(axes),
    Create(speed_curve),
    Write(speed_label),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(2)
self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(speed_curve, water_curve),
    ReplacementTransform(speed_label, water_label),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(3.8)  # Complete 11.8s segment

# Segment 3 (28.7-41.2s) - Two branches of calculus
branch_diagram = VGroup()
diff_box = Rectangle(height=2, width=3)
int_box = Rectangle(height=2, width=3)
diff_text = Text("Differential\nCalculus", font_size=24)
int_text = Text("Integral\nCalculus", font_size=24)

diff_box.shift(LEFT*3)
int_box.shift(RIGHT*3)
diff_text.move_to(diff_box)
int_text.move_to(int_box)

arrow1 = Arrow(start=ORIGIN, end=diff_box.get_right(), color=WHITE)
arrow2 = Arrow(start=ORIGIN, end=int_box.get_left(), color=WHITE)

self.play(
    FadeOut(axes),
    FadeOut(water_curve),
    FadeOut(water_label),
    run_time=1.5
)
self.play(
    Create(diff_box),
    Create(int_box),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Write(diff_text),
    Write(int_text),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Create(arrow1), Create(arrow2), run_time=2)
self.wait(5)  # Complete 12.5s segment

# Segment 4 (41.2-50.7s) - Differential calculus example
derivative = MathTex(r"\frac{d}{dx}f(x) = \lim_{h \to 0}\frac{f(x+h)-f(x)}{h}")
derivative.next_to(diff_box, DOWN)

self.play(
    Write(derivative),
    Indicate(diff_box, color=YELLOW),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(6.6)  # Complete 9.6s segment

# Segment 5 (50.7-71.8s) - Integral calculus example
integral = MathTex(r"\int_a^b f(x)\,dx = \lim_{n \to \infty}\sum_{i=1}^n f(x_i)\Delta x")
integral.next_to(int_box, DOWN)

self.play(
    Write(integral),
    Indicate(int_box, color=YELLOW),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(18.1)  # Complete 21.1s segment

# Segment 6 (71.8-81.5s) - Applications summary
applications = VGroup(
    Text("Physics", font_size=24),
    Text("Engineering", font_size=24),
    Text("Economics", font_size=24),
    Text("Biology", font_size=24)
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5)
applications.move_to(ORIGIN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(derivative),
    FadeOut(integral),
    FadeOut(diff_box),
    FadeOut(int_box),
    FadeOut(diff_text),
    FadeOut(int_text),
    FadeOut(arrow1),
    FadeOut(arrow2),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Write(applications), run_time=3)
self.wait(4.7)  # Complete 9.7s segment

section_title: The Power Rule for Integration: Reversing the Derivative
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-22.9s) - Introduction to integration as inverse of differentiation
title = Text("Integration: Reversing Differentiation", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
axes = Axes(
    x_range=[-3, 3],
    y_range=[-2, 6],
    axis_config={"include_tip": True}
)
original = axes.plot(lambda x: x**2, color=BLUE, x_range=[-2, 2])
derivative = axes.plot(lambda x: 2*x, color=RED, x_range=[-2, 2])

orig_label = MathTex("f(x) = x^2").next_to(original, RIGHT)
deriv_label = MathTex("f'(x) = 2x").next_to(derivative, LEFT)

arrows = VGroup(
    Arrow(start=orig_label, end=deriv_label, color=YELLOW),
    Arrow(start=deriv_label, end=orig_label, color=GREEN)
)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(axes), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(original), Write(orig_label), run_time=3)
self.play(Create(derivative), Write(deriv_label), run_time=3)
self.play(Create(arrows[0]), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(arrows[1]), run_time=2)
self.wait(8.9)  # Complete 22.9s segment

# Segment 2 (22.9-41.4s) - Introducing the Power Rule for Integration
power_rule_title = Text("The Power Rule for Integration", font_size=36).next_to(title, DOWN)
power_example = MathTex(
    r"\int x^n dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + C"
).scale(1.2).move_to(ORIGIN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(VGroup(original, derivative, orig_label, deriv_label, arrows)),
    Write(power_rule_title),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(Write(power_example), run_time=3)
self.wait(12.5)  # Complete 18.5s segment

# Segment 3 (41.4-59.5s) - Displaying the Power Rule formula with example
example = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\int x^2 dx"),
    MathTex(r"= \frac{x^{2+1}}{2+1}"),
    MathTex(r"= \frac{x^3}{3} + C")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(power_example, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(
    power_example.animate.shift(UP * 1.5),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Write(example[0]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(example[1]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(example[2]), run_time=2)
self.wait(10.1)  # Complete 18.1s segment

# Segment 4 (59.5-92.2s) - Explaining the constant of integration
c_explanation = VGroup(
    Text("Why do we need + C?", font_size=36),
    MathTex(r"\frac{d}{dx}(x^3 + 5) = 3x^2"),
    MathTex(r"\frac{d}{dx}(x^3 - 2) = 3x^2"),
    MathTex(r"\frac{d}{dx}(x^3 + C) = 3x^2")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(example, DOWN, buff=1)

highlight_c = SurroundingRectangle(example[2][-2], color=YELLOW)

self.play(
    FadeOut(power_example),
    example.animate.shift(UP * 1.5),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Write(c_explanation[0]), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(highlight_c), run_time=1)
self.play(Write(c_explanation[1]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(c_explanation[2]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(c_explanation[3]), run_time=2)
self.wait(21.8)  # Complete 32.8s segment

section_title: Understanding Derivatives: The Slope of a Curve
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-13.2s) - Introduction
title = Text("Understanding Derivatives", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("The Slope of a Curve", font_size=36).next_to(title, DOWN)
function = MathTex(r"f(x) = x^2").scale(1.5)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(function), run_time=2)
self.wait(7.2)

# Segment 2 (13.2-26.0s) - Drawing parabola
axes = Axes(
    x_range=[-4, 4, 1],
    y_range=[0, 16, 2],
    axis_config={"include_tip": True}
).scale(0.8)
labels = axes.get_axis_labels(x_label="x", y_label="f(x)")
curve = axes.plot(lambda x: x**2, color=BLUE)
curve_label = MathTex(r"f(x)=x^2").next_to(curve, RIGHT, buff=0.5)

self.play(
    FadeOut(function),
    Create(axes),
    Create(labels),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(Create(curve), Write(curve_label), run_time=4)
self.wait(5.7)

# Segment 3 (26.0-33.6s) - Tangent line
point_x = 2
point = axes.coords_to_point(point_x, point_x**2)
slope = 2 * point_x
tangent_line = axes.get_secant_slope_group(
    x=point_x,
    graph=curve,
    dx=0.01,
    secant_line_color=YELLOW,
    secant_line_length=4
)

self.play(Create(tangent_line), run_time=4)
self.wait(3.7)

# Segment 4 (33.6-42.2s) - Showing derivative formula
derivative = MathTex(r"f'(x) = 2x").to_edge(UP + RIGHT)
arrow = Arrow(derivative.get_left(), point, color=WHITE)

self.play(
    Write(derivative),
    GrowArrow(arrow),
    run_time=4
)
self.wait(4.6)

# Segment 5 (42.2-53.3s) - Calculating slope at x=3
point_3 = axes.coords_to_point(3, 9)
tangent_3 = axes.get_secant_slope_group(
    x=3,
    graph=curve,
    dx=0.01,
    secant_line_color=GREEN,
    secant_line_length=4
)
calc = MathTex(r"f'(3) = 2(3) = 6").next_to(derivative, DOWN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(tangent_line),
    FadeOut(arrow),
    Create(tangent_3),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(Write(calc), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.1)

# Segment 6 (53.3-63.1s) - Power rule
power_rule = MathTex(r"\frac{d}{dx}(x^n) = nx^{n-1}").to_edge(LEFT)
box = SurroundingRectangle(power_rule, color=YELLOW)

self.play(
    Write(power_rule),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(Create(box), run_time=2)
self.wait(4.8)

# Segment 7 (63.1-71.1s) - Summary
summary = Text("Key to understanding function behavior", font_size=36).to_edge(DOWN)

self.play(
    Write(summary),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(5)
